definitions.explanation: The actual item as opposed to a picture, replica, or description.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}より{実物|じつぶつ}の{方|ほう}がきれいだ。
examples.english: The real thing is prettier than the photo.

examples.japanese: {実物|じつぶつ}を{見|み}てから{決|き}めたい。
examples.english: I want to decide after seeing the actual item.

examples.japanese: {実物|じつぶつ}{大|だい}の{模型|もけい}が{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: A life-size model is on display.

examples.japanese: ネットで{見|み}た{時|とき}は{良|よ}さそうだったが、{実物|じつぶつ}は{思|おも}ったより{小|ちい}さかった。
examples.english: It looked good when I saw it online, but the actual item was smaller than I expected.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}で{有名|ゆうめい}な{絵画|かいが}の{実物|じつぶつ}を{初|はじ}めて{見|み}たとき、その{大|おお}きさと{迫力|はくりょく}に{圧倒|あっとう}された。
examples.english: When I saw the real painting at the art museum for the first time, I was overwhelmed by its size and impact.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{実物|じつぶつ}を{見|み}る (to see the actual thing)
・{実物|じつぶつ}の{方|ほう}が〜 (the real one is more ~)
・{実物|じつぶつ}{大|だい} (life-size, actual size)

OPPOSITE CONCEPTS:
・{写真|しゃしん} (photo)
・{模型|もけい} (model)
・レプリカ (replica)
・{複製|ふくせい} (reproduction)

FOR PEOPLE:
{実物|じつぶつ} can also refer to a person in real life vs. their photo or media appearance.
{例|れい}: {彼|かれ}は{実物|じつぶつ}の{方|ほう}がかっこいい。(He's more handsome in person.)

[Register: Neutral]
